name: ClimateBench Climate Emulation Benchmark
description: ClimateBench is a benchmark for climate emulation, evaluating models that approximate the response of the climate system to different forcing scenarios. It is designed to assess how well data-driven or hybrid methods reproduce climate variables and derived climate responses under controlled experimental settings.
evaluation_method: error-based comparison against reference climate model outputs using metrics such as RMSE, bias, and correlation across variables and scenarios
notes: Benchmark focuses on reproducing climate responses rather than direct weather prediction; exact scores vary by target variable and scenario setup.
